title: VTA DID-Template List — payload
description: List the DID templates in one scope on a VTA. Omit `contextId` to list the global templates (any authenticated caller); set it to list the templates scoped to that context (requires access to the context). The success response is the array of persisted DidTemplateRecords for the selected scope.

contextId.description: Scope selector. Absent: the global scope. Present: the context whose templates are listed; the caller MUST have access to that context.

Response.title: VTA DID-Template List — response payload
Response.description: Every stored template in the selected scope, in an array.

templates.description: Every stored template in the selected scope, sorted by name; empty when none exist.
